unit.why: An eyewitness memorate: the master exorcises a possessed man outside the beit midrash and a possessed woman at the women's section on the same day, then tells the tsaddik of Radoshitz that he uses no kavvanot.

stories.start_quote: והנה בעיני ראיתי כי כמה רוחות רעות
stories.end_quote: שוטים שיראים מפני, ולכן המה בורחים
stories.summary_en: The master drives an evil spirit from a bound, Polish-speaking man with a slap and from a woman with a rebuke, and later tells the Radoshitz tsaddik that he uses no kavvanot because the spirits are simply fools who fear him.
